Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Aira and Zapier share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Aira and Zapier share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Aira only if your buying job matches “AI-powered digital accessibility platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.” rather than Zapier's shape. Choose Zapier only if your buying job matches “Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 t” rather than Aira's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Aira is shaped for AI-powered digital accessibility platform — affiliate partner in the A whereas Zapier is shaped for Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Company-size focus: Aira (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Zapier (solo, micro, small-business).
- Researched limits: Aira — Accessibility niche — not general AI writing platform; Zapier — Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast.
